status: FROZEN before any v2 result exists. v1 generator (generator_v1.json), scoring, engine and v1 results are unchanged and remain authoritative for v1.
purpose: Paired comparison of price-only vs event-aware strategies on IDENTICAL worlds with indicator-schema-v2 information of controlled quality.

worlds.note: fresh seeds via the new experiment id; no evolution, no selection, so the world bank is evaluation-only

event_aware: EVT_AWARE_v1 overlay in gym/event_aware_v2.py, PARAMS fixed (window 20, threshold 2.0, tilt 0.03); identity hashed from parent+params; NOT Kim/Sam/D-primary-rank3
conditions: revised (preliminary wrong-by-one-bucket, 25% wrong direction, later corrected)
contradictory (50% of releases get an opposing report)
placebo (a feed generated from a DIFFERENT world's events)
engine: v1 EngineParams defaults (18% ceiling, 12% halt, 10bps slippage, 5bps commission), unchanged
primary_metric: paired per-world difference in annualized return, event-aware minus the same base price-only
decision_rule: event-aware is said to help only if, in the clean condition, the paired-difference mean is >0 with 95% bootstrap CI lower bound >0 for at least one base AND the placebo condition shows no comparable gain; every condition and base is reported, including negatives
caveats: synthetic assumptions only; the indicator-to-price link is assumed from the generator, not estimated
real-data module found indicators priced on release with no post-release drift, so large gains would indicate generator assumptions not market truth
